freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册即享免费额度（每 4 周周期重置），当前免费模型为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、MiMo V2.6 Flash 与 TH-Rudder；免费名单为促销性质、会随时间轮换，以官网当前页面为准。提供 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口。
freeTierSummary.en: Free allowance after sign-up (resets every 4 weeks), currently covering DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Flash, and TH-Rudder; the free lineup is promotional and rotates — check the official pricing page for the current list. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
